crossRefs.note: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has…

translations.web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
translations.bsb: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
translations.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
translations.asv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
